overallSummary: Fabio Giglietto maintains a robust and highly targeted academic social media presence across Bluesky, LinkedIn, and Mastodon, with a total following of 3,580. His content effectively reaches researchers and data scientists interested in computational social science, disinformation, and coordinated behavior. Across all platforms, posts showcasing research milestones, funding awards, and tool releases (such as CooRnet v2.0) generate substantial engagement, driven by an active professional network.

contentThemes.description: Research updates, conference announcements, and tool releases (e.g., CooRnet v2.0) focusing on detecting coordinated link-sharing and disinformation.
Job openings and research opportunities, including postdoctoral hiring and PhD student recruitment.
Announcements regarding newly awarded research grants, paper publications, and academic achievements.

recommendations: Leverage Bluesky's highly active sharing culture by focusing on visual summaries of new research papers to maximize reposts.
Increase posting frequency on LinkedIn to better capitalize on its large follower base (1,850 followers) for professional announcements and hiring.
Utilize Mastodon for technical and developer-focused updates, as tool-related announcements like CooRnet updates perform well there.

platformInsights.bluesky: Bluesky serves as the most engaging platform proportionally, achieving a 6.14% average engagement rate. It is particularly effective for community-driven sharing, as evidenced by high repost rates on new publications and research opportunities.
platformInsights.mastodon: Mastodon provides steady engagement (4.55% average rate) from a highly technical audience. Tool updates like CooRnet v2.0 resonate strongly, making it ideal for developer and open-source communications.
platformInsights.linkedin: LinkedIn generates the highest absolute engagement, led by major career and institutional updates such as grant wins (107 engagements). It remains the premier platform for professional recruitment and high-visibility milestones.
